name: Nekome: Nazi Hunter

sources.excerpt: While at Game Developers Conference last week, I met with the team at ProbablyMonsters to get a hands-off demo of Nekome: Nazi Hunter.

sources.label: GamesBeat 公布报道
sources.excerpt: The game is part of a series of smaller, more focused games that don’t require huge budgets.

sources.excerpt: Nekome: Nazi Hunter approaches the Second World War from the personal perspective of Vano as he exacts revenge for the sadistic murders.

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整页面，确认没有 AI 生成内容披露栏；英文讨论区首页 15 个主题（总数 81），没有与 AI 使用相关的主题（已读的“jank unreal engine slop”一帖讨论的是画面与引擎，不涉及 AI）。本款单独检索 2 次、登记 34 条结果，读取 3 篇原始来源（Game Informer 前瞻、GamesBeat 公布报道、ProbablyMonsters 官方作品页），均未提及生成式 AI。游戏计划 2027 年第一季度发售，核查时尚未发售。八个领域均标为“未提及”。

english.summary: A third-person stealth action game in which Vano, a young Romani man whose family was murdered by Nazi soldiers, stalks enemy camps and takes revenge through brutal close-quarters combat. This review found no evidence of generative AI use: the Steam store page carries no AI disclosure and no related statement appeared in press coverage or on the developer page.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam store page and confirmed there is no AI-generated content disclosure; the English discussion homepage showed 15 topics (81 total) with none about AI use (the thread read, "jank unreal engine slop", concerns visuals and engine choice, not AI). This title was searched twice with 34 results logged and three raw sources read (Game Informer preview, GamesBeat announcement, ProbablyMonsters official page), none mentioning generative AI. The game is scheduled for Q1 2027 and was unreleased at review time. All eight areas are marked as not stated.
